frozen_OE_contrasts.infection_var: OE_treatment assigned infected/control, not post-assay InfectionStatus
frozen_OE_contrasts.outcome: assigned larva -> adult eclosion, not mating or flight-capable recruitment
frozen_OE_contrasts.statistic: (tropical-swamp adult fraction in elevated plots) - (tropical-swamp fraction in ambient plots)
frozen_OE_contrasts.unit: one experimental PlotNum for temperature stratum; all 4 original host×OE plant cells paired

interpretive_guardrails: Adult eclosion is NOT migratory success, adult flight capacity, realized wild colonization, mating or multi-generation reproduction.
Reproductive activity under fall-like conditions may indicate a switch toward residency, NOT necessarily improved lifetime fitness or successful overwintering.
No same larval cohort links 2021 Ragonese adult eclosion with 2019 Majewska reproductive status.
Do NOT multiply 219/239 by 97/263 or interpret 37% as an expected field replacement rate.
The 2019 adult-exposure and juvenile rearing studies are two separate trials, with different original denominators.
Host taxonomy and native/exotic origin are confounded for two milkweed species; OE and temperature effects cannot be generalized to all exotic hosts.

Both publications report the primary biological host physiology findings as prior art. New question requires independent natal-host, season, infection, emergence, reproductive state and migration/mating outcomes.
No direct assay of wild migrant destination or successful mating-offspring fate available in these sources.
